profile.bio: Most of my working life has gone into making operational data usable: four years of asset management for a commercial solar portfolio, with yield models that passed bank audits, mobile field capture and telemetry reconciliation when sensors went missing. Between roles I completed a three-month PPA engagement for EWE Trading and built a thirteen-host NixOS fleet from one flake — SSH certificate authority, per-host encrypted secrets, a sentinel watching disk, memory and generation age — alongside local language, speech and image models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. I am looking for systems work where operational data has to be trusted.

focus.title: Reproducible fleets
focus.body: Thirteen machines, one repository. Rebuilding a host, auditing it or handing it to someone else takes the commit, not a folder of install notes.

focus.title: Go services with bounded work
focus.body: One binary per service, serving HTML, JSON and a terminal UI. Small enough to read in an afternoon, and state is a log of what happened rather than a row someone edited.

focus.title: Operational data that ends in action
focus.body: CISA's exploited list as a time series and as clusters a team can finish this week. The output is a patch order, not another dashboard.

work.title: Multi-host NixOS fleet
work.description: I moved thirteen machines off per-host install notes and onto one repository. Rebuilding, auditing or handing over a host is now the commit plus one command; secrets are encrypted per host and certificates rotate on a schedule. The same fleet runs self-hosted services and scheduled sync agents for job search and data sync.

work.title: fibtransponder
work.description: I set out to build a stream detector and wrote the benchmark first. The measurement killed the first design, so what ships is the smaller claim: a state machine whose work per step stays bounded, with the corpus that falsified the rest in the repository.

work.title: Energy telemetry and valuation
work.description: Four years running the numbers behind a solar portfolio above $100M: yield and valuation models that satisfied bank auditors, mobile capture for field technicians, and a reconciliation step that turned a dead sensor into a known error instead of a good month. Also implemented Salesforce and kept a small office's Microsoft 365, network and Wi-Fi running.

work.title: Smart Energy 360
work.description: Managed a USD 100M+ project pipeline for commercial clients moving to cleaner electricity, with the sustainability strategy and the risk advice that went with it.

work.title: Fraunhofer ISE
work.description: Measured heliostat imperfections with interferometry: C++ for the instrument, Python for analysis and 3D geometry.

work.title: Halliburton
work.description: Two frac crews in the Bakken shale: chemicals and equipment faults fixed on site, twelve-hour shifts, and the safety training for the crew.

work.title: Bountystash
work.description: Built and ran Bountystash: a Go service that turns a request into an immutable, content-addressed specification, with append-only events, a terminal UI and curl endpoints in one binary.

lab.title: The KEV lab
lab.body: Two public tools read CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue. kev-time plots exploitation over time, so a trend shows up before a report does. kelly-svg groups entries into clusters a team can work through, so patch order follows effort and exposure. Both are static SVG and plain HTML, readable on a phone during an incident. concept.bountystash.com puts the same data into a programme: a sample queue grouped by effort.

hire.title: What I am looking for
hire.body: A senior or lead systems role where infrastructure, automation and operational data meet: platform engineering on Kubernetes with GitOps and infrastructure as code, cloud platform work on GCP or Azure, site reliability, or the datacenter and AI infrastructure underneath. Remote from a CET base, or on site in Freiburg and the Upper Rhine.
